title: Zero Copy Federation: Curated Lakehouse Views

steps.prompt: An enterprise federates a 140-column raw transaction table from Snowflake into Data Cloud for Agentforce grounding. Data Cloud only needs 12 fields, and primary keys require deduplication. Which architecture aligns with Salesforce Well-Architected guidance to clean at the source while minimizing egress overhead?

options.label: Curated Snowflake View Enforcing Uniqueness and Column Pruning
options.rationale: Curated views push filtering, deduplication, and type casting to the source engine. This approach minimizes network data transmission, enforces identity uniqueness before mapping, and provides direct one-to-one alignment with standard objects.

options.label: Formula Field Expressions Configured on Federated Lake Objects
options.rationale: Applying dynamic formulas across hundreds of unpruned federated columns prevents optimal query predicate pushdown to the warehouse, increasing query latency and transfer volume.

options.label: Identity Resolution Rule Sets Applied to Uncleaned Transactions
options.rationale: Identity resolution creates unified individual customer profiles from party identifiers. It cannot resolve duplicate transaction records or normalize non-standard transactional timestamps.
